verdict.rationale: Asana's AI Teammates feature claims 'shared memory' that carries forward preferences and context from completed tasks so context isn't repeated, which loosely supports personalization, but there is no evidence of the assistant learning a user's tone/shorthand or tailoring writing style/output specifically. missing for 10: explicit evidence of tone/voice/shorthand learning, style adaptation in generated text, user-level personalization controls, and independent corroboration of this behavior working in practice.
